$comment: Tools for each build. Our own words; Amazon links are plain search links built from `query` (no ASINs, prices, ratings or images). Rules add up: default, then category, archetype, category+archetype combos, hardware kinds, then tall pieces. `slugs` can add or drop tools for one piece. Checked by scripts/tools-check.mjs.

tools.name: Hex key set
tools.note: Most boxes include one; a set with a handle is kinder to your wrist.
tools.query: hex key allen wrench set metric

tools.name: Phillips #2 screwdriver
tools.note: The one screwdriver almost every build needs.

tools.name: Flathead screwdriver
tools.note: Turns cam locks and pries out stuck dowels.

tools.name: Stubby screwdriver
tools.note: For screws inside drawers and tight corners.

tools.name: Rubber mallet
tools.note: Taps dowels and back-panel nails in without dents.

tools.name: Cordless drill/driver with bits
tools.note: Saves your hands on long screw runs. Use a low clutch setting.
tools.query: cordless drill driver with bit set

tools.name: Tape measure
tools.note: Checks it fits the spot and marks where the wall studs are.

tools.name: Level
tools.note: Keeps shelves, drawers and desktops true.

tools.name: Wood glue
tools.note: Optional: a drop on wobbly dowel joints.

tools.name: Furniture pads
tools.note: Felt pads protect floors and help it slide.

tools.name: Wall-anchor kit
tools.note: For tip-over straps and wall mounting. Anchor dressers and tall shelves to the wall.
tools.query: furniture anti tip wall anchor kit

tools.name: Utility knife
tools.note: Opens the box. Cut shallow so you don't scratch panels.
